Sandbox_AnimalsAttackZombies_Bulls_toolt: Bulls charge zombies that come near them or their herd, all year round. Dairy bulls are the quickest to fight, as they are in real life.
Sandbox_AnimalsAttackZombies_Boars_toolt: Boars charge zombies that come near them or their herd, all year round, and their tusks can knock a zombie down.
Sandbox_AnimalsAttackZombies_Rams_toolti: Rams charge zombies that come near them or their flock. They are at their most aggressive in the breeding season, September to February.
Sandbox_AnimalsAttackZombies_Roosters_to: Roosters go after zombies that come near their hens. A rooster is small, so he harasses a zombie more than he hurts it.
Sandbox_AnimalsAttackZombies_TurkeyToms_: Turkey toms go after zombies that come near their flock, most of all in the spring breeding season, April and May. Like roosters, they harass more than they hurt.
Sandbox_AnimalsAttackZombies_Sows_toolti: A sow charges zombies that come near her piglets. Without piglets she runs from zombies like any other pig.
Sandbox_AnimalsAttackZombies_Cows_toolti: A cow charges zombies that come near her calf. Without a calf she runs from zombies like any other cow.
Sandbox_AnimalsAttackZombies_EngageRange: How close, in tiles, a zombie has to come to an animal, its herd or its young before the animal takes it on. The default of 6 is the distance at which vanilla animals start running from a zombie. It varies by animal: an aggressive one reacts from further away and a calm one from closer, beef bulls from a little closer than dairy bulls, and rams and turkey toms from closer outside their breeding season (see the Species page).
Sandbox_AnimalsAttackZombies_DamageMulti: Scales the damage every animal does to zombies. Each species' own damage is on the Species page, and an animal's strength gene still counts.
Sandbox_AnimalsAttackZombies_HerdRadius_: A male defends the animals of his kind within this many tiles of him, as well as himself. Fighters of the same kind this close also stand together against a crowd.
Sandbox_AnimalsAttackZombies_YoungRadius: A mother defends her babies while they are within this many tiles of her. With none that close, she runs from zombies like any other animal.
Sandbox_AnimalsAttackZombies_FleeRange_t: Tiles at which the animals this mod covers run from a zombie when they are not fighting: a species turned off above, or a mother without young. Vanilla animals run at 6. 0: they ignore zombies instead.
Sandbox_AnimalsAttackZombies_GeneInfluen: How much an animal's own genes count. The aggressiveness gene sets its range, how readily it charges and how long it warns; the strength gene sets how hard it hits. 100: as described. 0: every animal behaves like an average one. 200: the differences between animals doubled.
Sandbox_AnimalsAttackZombies_Hesitation_: Animals do not always charge the moment a zombie is in range. They stand and watch it, and the closer it gets to them or what they guard, the likelier they are to charge; one that comes right up is always charged. Mothers with young commit fastest and turkey toms bluff the most, and aggressive animals are quicker to go. Off: every animal charges as soon as a zombie is in range, and the options below down to Always Charge Within do nothing.
Sandbox_AnimalsAttackZombies_Aggression_: How readily animals commit to a charge while sizing a zombie up. At the defaults, a typical bull facing a zombie that stands still waits about 12 seconds when it is at the edge of his range, 5 at two thirds, 3 at half and 1.5 when it is close. 2 halves those waits, 0.5 doubles them.
Sandbox_AnimalsAttackZombies_ChargeChanc: Charge Chance At Edge Of Range (%%)
The chance, every half second, that an animal charges a zombie at the very edge of its range, before temper, genes and Animal Aggression.
The same chance for a zombie right beside what the animal guards. In between, it climbs steeply as the zombie gets closer.
Sandbox_AnimalsAttackZombies_AlwaysCharg: A zombie this close to what an animal guards, as a percentage of the animal's range, is always charged. 15 is within 0.9 tiles at a range of 6. 0: never certain.
Sandbox_AnimalsAttackZombies_WarningDisp: Before charging, an animal stops, squares up to the zombie and calls out, the way a bull bellows and paws the ground first. How long each species warns is on the Species page, and aggressive animals are quicker. A zombie that walks into reach meanwhile is struck at once. Off: animals charge without warning.
Sandbox_AnimalsAttackZombies_WarningStan: A zombie that backs off further than this from what the animal guards, as a percentage of its range, ends the warning, and the animal lets it go.
Sandbox_AnimalsAttackZombies_CrowdLimit: Crowd Size That Makes Animals Run
Sandbox_AnimalsAttackZombies_CrowdLimit_: How many zombies within Crowd Counting Distance make an animal run instead of fight, breaking off any fight it is in. Every other fighter of its kind within Herd Guarding Distance raises the limit by one, so a group of bulls stands up to more than one bull alone. 0: animals never back off, however many zombies come.
Sandbox_AnimalsAttackZombies_CrowdRadius: Zombies within this many tiles of an animal count toward a crowd. A hurt animal also runs from zombies this close.
Sandbox_AnimalsAttackZombies_RetreatHeal: An animal whose health is below this percentage does not fight, breaks off any fight it is in, and runs from zombies instead. Zombies never hurt animals, so this is for animals hurt some other way, such as starving or hit by a car. 0: animals fight at any health.
Sandbox_AnimalsAttackZombies_ChaseDistan: How many tiles beyond its range from what it guards an animal follows a zombie before letting it go.
Sandbox_AnimalsAttackZombies_StuckTime_t: Seconds an animal keeps trying to reach a zombie it gets no closer to, behind a fence say, before giving up on it.
Sandbox_AnimalsAttackZombies_GiveUpTime_: Seconds an animal leaves a zombie alone after giving up on it, so it does not pace a fence forever.
Sandbox_AnimalsAttackZombies_MaxFightTim: Seconds an animal fights one zombie before giving up on it.
Sandbox_AnimalsAttackZombies_PauseMin_to: An animal pauses between strikes for a random time between this and the longest pause below.
Sandbox_AnimalsAttackZombies_ChargeRunDi: An animal further than this from the zombie charges at a run; closer, it walks up.
Sandbox_AnimalsAttackZombies_RunUpDistan: A first hit after a charge at least this long is harder for a zombie to stay standing under.
Sandbox_AnimalsAttackZombies_RunUpKnockd: Added to the knockdown chance of that first hit, for species that can knock zombies down at all.
Sandbox_AnimalsAttackZombies_BullDamage_: Zombie health one hit takes, before the strength gene and the Damage Multiplier. A zombie has about 2 at normal toughness.
Sandbox_AnimalsAttackZombies_BullKnockdo: Chance that a hit knocks the zombie off its feet. Any other hit makes it stagger.
Sandbox_AnimalsAttackZombies_BullTemper_: How readily it commits to a charge while sizing a zombie up. 1 is a bull's; mothers with young are 1.3 and turkey toms, the biggest bluffers, 0.8.
Sandbox_AnimalsAttackZombies_BullWarnMin: Its warning display lasts a random time between this and the longest warning, shorter for an aggressive animal.

Sandbox_AnimalsAttackZombies_RutRange_to: Rams' and turkey toms' range outside their breeding season, as a percentage of their usual range. With the game's mating seasons turned off, it is always breeding season.
Sandbox_AnimalsAttackZombies_BullHolstei: A Holstein bull's range as a percentage of the Engage Range. Dairy bulls are the most aggressive.
Sandbox_AnimalsAttackZombies_BullSimment: A Simmental bull's range as a percentage of the Engage Range.
Sandbox_AnimalsAttackZombies_BullAngus_t: An Angus bull's range as a percentage of the Engage Range. Beef bulls are the calmest.
